_comment: Declarative record of the Cloudflare Pages project's runtime configuration.
Why this file exists: Pages bindings are NOT covered by workers/wrangler.toml.
That file configures the standalone Worker. Production serves /api/* from a
_worker.js bundled into the Pages output (workers/src/pages-entry.ts), and that
function reads its bindings from the PAGES PROJECT, which is configured through
the dashboard or API and was therefore recorded nowhere.
The consequence, observed in production on 2026-07-26: the project had no D1
binding at all. Auth succeeded and /health returned 200, but every data route
500'd with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')" because
c.env.DB was undefined. Nothing in the repo could have revealed that.
Assert with: node scripts/sync-pages-config.mjs --check   (used by CI)
Secret VALUES are deliberately absent — only the names are asserted, so this
_accessNote: ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN and ACCESS_AUD are intentionally NOT in requiredEnvVarNames.
Setting both switches workers/src/index.ts from shared-token auth to per-user
Access identity. They are absent today, which is why GET /api/auth/whoami still
reports mode:"shared-token". Add them here once Access is live, so that a
deploy which silently drops them fails the --check instead of quietly
downgrading the whole site to a bearer token that ships in the JS bundle.
